name: Joys of Omosh
summary: After an adventurer's great help, Orokk Omosh shares a family tradition in Orgrimmar. The veteran blacksmith brushes off his tears as soot, then performs the Omosh dance of joy to pass down an unusual piece of family heritage.

sections.title: A Soot-Stained Tear
sections.body: Near Orgrimmar's scorching forge, Orokk Omosh is known for heavy hammer blows, not tears. The burly blacksmith has received great help from you, and the kindness overwhelms him. He stubbornly blames a stray bit of soot in his eye rather than admit he is weeping.

sections.title: The Omosh Tradition
sections.body: Before you part, Orokk says he must share one last secret of the Omosh family. He performs the vigorous, exhausting Omosh dance of joy for his apprentice, then teaches the apprentice to strike with an iron fist.

faq.answer: Orokk Omosh is an orc blacksmith in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. He takes fierce pride in his family's craft and lineage, and keeps lively traditions alongside his smithing.
Orokk says forge soot is trapped in his eye, but your help has deeply moved him. He has found someone worthy of sharing his family's traditions with.

faq.q: What is the Omosh dance of joy?
faq.answer: The Omosh dance of joy is a vigorous routine passed down through Orokk's family. It leaves him deeply tired, and he has not practiced it in a very long time.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: It takes place in Orgrimmar, around the blacksmithing forge in the Valley of Honor where Orokk Omosh works his metal.
Orokk teaches you the Omosh dance of joy and promises to pass on the knowledge of the fist of iron, binding smith and adventurer.

faq.q: Can Alliance players participate in this quest?
faq.answer: No. Orokk Omosh is allied with the Horde and lives within Orgrimmar's fortified walls, so only Horde adventurers can meet him there.

angles.text: For a smith, Orokk's sentimental family dance offers a humorous, tender glimpse of a veteran craftsman's life beyond the forge.
In Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor, martial pride meets Orokk's tearful joy and spirited dance amid the clash of steel.
